note: caiso-164 promotes caiso_zonal_loss_surface: CAISO's INTERNAL network moves from LOSSLESS -- the model's implicit ESTIMATE that transmission losses are zero -- to CAISO's OWN PUBLISHED marginal delivery-factor surface. Each internal link splits into a one-way pair whose receiving-end energy-balance coefficient is 1 - eps(month), eps = max(0, (dev_to - dev_from)/(1 + dev_to)), with dev_z,m = SUM(MCL_z,t)/SUM(MCE_t) derived by scripts/data/derive_caiso_loss_surface.py from the committed CAISO DAM component record (CAISO writes LMP = MCE + MCC + MCL; Tariff SS27.1.1 / BPM for Market Operations SS6). Prices stay LP duals (rule 4). ZERO FREE PARAMETERS: the same frozen estimator as the MISO/PJM analogues applied to CAISO's own data, nothing swept, blended or tuned, no residual consulted; the only non-measured device is the 0.001 $/MWh loss-pair flow tiebreak (storage-eps class, rule 9). The DOF ledger is carried VERBATIM at 11 entries / 9 residual, ASSERTED by scripts/gen_caiso164_attestation.py rather than assumed. Rule 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE]: every value is CAISO's own, in CAISO's own CAISO_loss_surface.csv; per rule 28(d) the PJM K and MISO R verdicts do NOT fill this cell -- CAISO entered as U and derived its own parameters. CHARTERED ON A MEASURED DECOMPOSITION, NOT ON A HYPOTHESIS. caiso-163 SS5 left the north-south basis miss open and named ONE untested hypothesis (reduced topology / zonal aggregation). caiso-164 SS0 instead used CAISO's own published component split -- MCE is identical at every node, so the hub basis is EXACTLY dMCC + dMCL -- and measured that the NP15-ZP26 basis is 80.2/87.2/81.7 % CONGESTION and 19.8/12.8/18.3 % LOSS (+1.176/+1.102/+1.049 of +5.947/+8.576/+5.727 $/MWh). The lossless LP had NO representation of the loss column at all, so rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] governs: a measured physical network property replaces a zero-estimate. THE PROMOTION'S CLAIM IS STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY, AND THE HEADLINE IS THE SIGN. Against a same-HEAD flag-off control (2026-08-04-control-flagoff-lossless-baseline), mean NP15-ZP26 goes -0.0768/-0.1086/-0.0841 -> +0.2362/+0.1258/+0.1113 $/MWh: CAISO's north-south basis carries the CORRECT SIGN FOR THE FIRST TIME, NP15 dearer than ZP26 as the real market has it in ~100 % of hours. Hours separated go 237/414/284 (2.7/4.7/3.2 %) -> 3,332/2,522/2,388 (38.0/28.8/27.3 %), and hours with NP15 DEARER -- the measured direction -- go 3/0/1 -> 3,082/2,120/2,108. That recovers 26.6/21.3/18.6 % of the measured LOSS component and 5.26/2.73/3.41 % of the total measured basis. BOUNDED EX ANTE AND ADVERSARIALLY GATED: PRECHECK SS4 gate S2 pre-registered that the arm may not move the basis by MORE than the measured dMCL, and the attestation generator FAILS if it does; the realised movement uses 26.6/21.3/18.6 % of that ceiling. WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO, STATED AS PROMINENTLY AS WHAT IT DOES. The remaining 80-87 % of the basis is CONGESTION and is NOT addressed. SS0 measured the congestion miss to be a FREQUENCY-AND-DIRECTION miss, not a magnitude one (freq ratio 0.035-0.054x vs magnitude 0.26-0.44x), and in the top decile of measured |dMCC| -- 100/100/99.9 % of it S->N -- the pre-arm model separated in ZERO of 864/879/876 hours across the entire lag sweep. It attributes that to an INTRA-SP15 corridor: LA_BASIN carries 77-83 TWh of load at a 0.11-0.12 belly renewable/load ratio and absorbs the whole ZP26+SP15_rest belly surplus through a never-binding 12,008 MW one-way link, so no surplus reaches Path 15 and it never binds S->N with a positive dual. Reproducing that needs CAISO nodal / intra-zonal congestion data, which is NOT in data/raw -- FILED as a data blocker and NOT approximated with a fitted proxy (rules 1/13). No compensating adder, haircut or offset was added; the north-south basis is NOT claimed as closed. THIS IS NOT A C3a ARM: C3a-2025 is unchanged and remains the OWNER's ledgered caveat on the caiso-141 A2 non-public hourly pumped-storage data wall. LIVENESS ON FLOWS AND THE LOSS ARRAY, NEVER ON PRICES (the caiso-162/163 standing lesson), and checked BEFORE solving: the pre-solve wiring probe (scripts/probes/caiso164_wiring_probe.py, exit 0) confirmed the call site fires on the calibration lane (links 6->8 all years), that the builder REFUSES an unsplit topology, that the measured gradient orients the loss S->N (Path 15 S->N eps 0.01936/0.02516/0.02645, N->S clamped) -- the same direction the measured congestion binds in -- and that the caiso-163 published Path 15 / Path 26 directional ratings SURVIVE the one-way split exactly (both orientations, signs [-1,+1], caps 3,265/5,400 and 4,000/3,000 unchanged). In the solve the control was measured carrying 6.079/4.352/3.820 TWh of real S->N energy on Path 15 over 3,277/2,834/2,733 hours, so the mechanism had something to act on and is NOT inert; zero treatment hours exceed any published cap. The derive's offline acceptance passed 6/6 pair-years in the miso-76 B1 band at 1.04-1.06x, and the MCE identity holds exactly (0.00e+00) in all three years. ZERO CRITERION FLIPS against the incumbent: C1 PASS, C2 PASS, C3a CAVEAT, C3b PASS, C3c CAVEAT, C4 PASS, and protective C6/C7/C8 all PASS -- determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS with the same 2 ledgered slots, NO new caveat slot spent. (2) Two of the five CAISO zones -- LA_BASIN and SDGE -- carry interpolated=True in the surface: CAISO's DLAP component record is not in data/raw, so these two load pockets inherit the SP15 generation hub's measured deviation under rule 14's 'reconciled version of the real data' clause rather than an invented scalar. The three zones carrying the quantity under test (NP15, ZP26, SP15_rest) each have their own measured hub. disposition_note: DETERMINATION CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, CARRIED OVER UNCHANGED from the caiso-162 keeper: the same 2 of 3 non-protective ledgered slots (C3c-2023/24 and C3a-2025, both the OWNER's act of 2026-07-30 at caiso-145), protective 0 of 1, 0 FAILs. NO NEW CAVEAT SLOT IS SPENT -- installing published directional ratings with zero free parameters creates no caveat. ALL NINE CRITERIA ARE IDENTICAL BETWEEN THE CONTROL AND THIS KEEPER: C1, C2, C3b PASS; C4 PASS; protective C6, C7, C8 PASS; C3a-2025 unchanged at +12.0%; C3c-2023/24 unchanged. Zero flips in either direction. THIS KEEPER OPENS A ROOT-CAUSE ISSUE RATHER THAN CLOSING ONE, AND SAYS SO RATHER THAN BURYING IT. Installing the published ratings makes Path 15 bind for the first time, but in only 2.7% / 4.7% / 3.2% of hours, whereas the REAL Path 15 separates NP15 from ZP26 in ~100% of hours and carries a mean NP15-over-ZP26 basis of +5.95 / +8.58 / +5.73 $/MWh against this keeper's -0.077 / -0.109 / -0.084; the NP15-over-SP15 basis likewise moves marginally FURTHER from the measured +2.34 / +7.99 / +6.01 (the Path-15 N->S tightening leg dominates the Path-26 S->N leg, trapping cheap northern energy in NP15). PRECHECK section 3 registered BEFORE the solve that the two legs push the ISO mean in OPPOSITE directions and predicted NO sign, so this is a resolved ambiguity, not a surprise. Under rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] and rule 1 [R-STRUCT] a marginally worse basis under a PUBLISHED limit is a DISCOVERED BUG, not a reason to restore the estimate: the symmetric TTC was silently absorbing a defect that lives elsewhere, most plausibly in the reduced two-link N-S topology and zonal aggregation, which cannot reproduce hourly Path-15 congestion whatever the ratings are. That investigation is OPEN and is NOT claimed as closed; no compensating adder, haircut or offset was added to hide it (rules 1/13). THIS IS NOT A C3a ARM and must not be reported as one -- C3a-2025 is unchanged at +12.0% and the level effect is nil. THE FOUR OWNER-DECISION DEFAULT FLIPS (retirement_rule -> pipeline, entry_rate_limits + entry_commissioning_lag armed, net_cone_forward_escalation -> reindex_gross; D-1 / D-2 / D-3a) were already carried by the incumbent, so they do not even appear as a config drift here -- the drift against BOTH the incumbent and the control is EXACTLY ONE FIELD, caiso_asymmetric_path_ratings, with zero schema drift. They are asserted anyway on the same two grounds: forecast-gated capacity-evolution machinery unreachable at mode='backcast', and identical across both arms. gen_caiso163_attestation.py FAILS if either condition breaks, if any undeclared delta appears against either comparator, if the DOF ledger moves, if the control never exceeded a published rating (which would make the mechanism INERT), or if any treatment hour exceeds one. RULE 22 leave-one-year-out: this session fits NOTHING and moves no free parameter, so LOYO reduces to the no-held-out-degradation check -- all three years show the same structural improvement and no criterion flips in any year, so no single year carries the result. CAISO still holds NO rule-22 calibration-complete marker, so every out-of-training year (2022, 2019, <=2021, H1-2026) stays fully quarantined; the holdout spend freeze is ACTIVE and outranks every marker. This session solved 2023/2024/2025 only (rule 16) and wrote no marker. THE STANDING DATA BLOCKERS ARE UNCHANGED and are not closable by an adder, haircut or residual-tuned value: C3a-2025 needs non-public hourly pumped-storage data and C3c-2023/24 needs the SoCalGas OFO declaration record, absent from data/raw.
